ctx.x: He was certainly a phenomenal player.

Oh, he was. You know, there's a little story there. I had told Andy Gibson, I said, "I want a trumpet player, a high note trumpet player, we can use, on the sensational side." He said, "Well, there are two of them, the guy that you liked when you were with Basie, played all the high lead there, and there's a guy here working in town by the name of Cat Anderson."
